plan.objective: The plan counts LEAPS units. Each unit pairs a MSTX Dec 2028 $33 call with a Jan 2028 $60 short call. Settlement proceeds buy units at that day's price. Real option prints estimate the unit price daily.
plan.routes_note: Holding to 10/2 ends with more units than closing now in 30% of history's paths. On your view it wins in 28%. Model averages count whole units at the model mid. Units are bought the session after each settlement at the settlement close. A real fill buys fewer. Priced at the 9/18 close. MSTX $18.73 and unit $3.97. No cash is counted. Market view is MSTX's own history. It uses every 10 session and 54 session move since listing. Drift is removed. Your view is the same prices one dollar higher. Phase 1 is marked at 100% vol at the 10/2 close. Closing now uses 135% vol, with the position about $23,800. Phase 2 uses 120% vol off the plan's strikes with 30% held as cash. Averages hide the spread. Phase 1 pays most between $16 and $18. It pays little outside $15 to $19. Closing deducts five cents across 450 calendars and fixes the unit count.
